theorems.name: Submission.slicing_mass_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → T.massOn W < ∞ ∧ T.boundary.massOn W < ∞) → ∀ (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzOnWith L f U → ∀ S : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn U m, (∀ t, IsSlice T f t (S t)) → ∀ W, IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → ∀ LW : ℝ≥0, (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl P)), x ∈ W → ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖₊ ≤ LW) → ∀ a b : ℝ, a < b → ∀ R : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), IsRestriction T {x | x ∈ U ∧ a < f x ∧ f x < b} R → ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g ∧ (∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, (S t).massOn W ≤ g t) ∧ ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, g t ≤ (LW : ℝ≥0∞) * R.massOn W
